description: This Java class 'Wizard' provides a GUI-based trigger wizard for controlling and testing engine trigger parameters, including sending commands, waiting for RPM to reach zero, and managing trigger steps.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Main class providing a GUI wizard for trigger testing and configuration.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Interface defining a step in the wizard, providing content component.

classes.name: WizardStepImpl
classes.description: Abstract class implementing WizardStep, providing next step chaining.

classes.name: SendCommand
classes.description: Wizard step that sends a command to the engine and waits for confirmation.

classes.name: WaitForZeroRpm
classes.description: Wizard step that waits until engine RPM reaches zero before proceeding.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Creates and returns the main GUI panel for the wizard.

methods.name: applyStep
methods.description: Transitions to the specified wizard step, updating GUI content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the GUI component for a given wizard step.

methods.name: scheduleRepaint
methods.description: Schedules a GUI update after a specified timeout.
